alt: 科展桌上華麗的模型外殼打開後空無一物，旁邊樸素的作品卻能實際運作。
scene_prompt: Modern school science-fair project: a dazzling ornate cardboard rocket exterior stands on a table, but its open side reveals it is hollow, with no working mechanism; beside it a modest plain but functional model built by another student. Teacher gently examines both; clear visual contrast between showy appearance and empty interior.
style_prompt: Original children's picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate pencil contours, soft watercolor, colored-pencil grain, ivory textured paper, muted natural palette. No readable text or logos.
